# SvgShapeRendering

<!-- Generated from the doc comments in the library. Do not edit this file. -->

The root `shape-rendering` hint of exported SVG.

Namespace `BonniePDF`.

## Values

- `Auto`: The SVG default: antialiased curves and charts look smooth (default).
- `OptimizeSpeed`: Favour speed over precision.
- `CrispEdges`: Snap shapes to the device pixel grid, so abutting module rectangles in barcodes, QR and Data Matrix leave no faint antialiasing seams. Text is governed by `text-rendering` and is unaffected.
- `GeometricPrecision`: Favour geometric accuracy over speed.
